create_LSQ_quantizer: create a LSQ quantizer for a PyTorch model with 8-bit weight quantization and learned stepsize
setup_LSQ_optimizer: setup the optimizer to tune the LSQ scale parameters for learned stepsize quantization training
quantize_tensor: quantize a PyTorch tensor using a learned scale factor and specified bit width with straight-through estimation
calculate_LSQ_model_size: calculate the differentiable estimated model size in MB for a LSQ quantized model including scale parameters
clear_LSQ_optimizer: clear LSQ scale parameters from an existing optimizer param group to remove them from training
